dispositions.reason: Vue needs a separate uncontrolled initial-mode prop; Avalonia property assignment has no controlled/uncontrolled split.
dispositions.alternative: Set FsusMarkdownEditor.Mode; its compiler-known default is Source.

dispositions.reason: This prop forwards an HTML id to the Web textarea and has no native-control semantic.
dispositions.alternative: Use the Avalonia control Name or AutomationProperties.AutomationId at the native host.

dispositions.reason: This prop forwards an HTML form field name and Avalonia controls do not submit HTML forms.
dispositions.alternative: Bind FsusMarkdownEditor.Document through the native view model.

dispositions.reason: CSP nonces authorize browser style/script nodes and do not apply to native Avalonia rendering.
dispositions.alternative: The native IFsusMarkdownEditorOutputHost owns renderer and print security policy.

dispositions.reason: This prop controls browser textarea writing-tool attributes rather than editor document semantics.
dispositions.alternative: Configure the native OS text-input service at the Avalonia host boundary.

dispositions.reason: This prop controls the HTML textarea spellcheck attribute rather than the shared document contract.
dispositions.alternative: Provide native language tooling through the host-owned writing-aids boundary.

dispositions.reason: The computed change emit is Vue component-model plumbing rather than a platform-neutral editor event.
The computed update emit implements Vue v-model and has no native event-name counterpart.
dispositions.alternative: Bind FsusMarkdownEditor.Document through Avalonia property binding.

dispositions.reason: The operation closes Web-owned command-palette chrome; native command composition belongs to the host.
dispositions.alternative: Close the host-composed native command palette.

dispositions.reason: The operation opens Web-owned command-palette chrome; native command composition belongs to the host.
dispositions.alternative: Open the host-composed native command palette.

dispositions.reason: The operation closes the Web search bar; the Avalonia editor deliberately exposes search data without built-in search chrome.
dispositions.alternative: Close host search chrome and call FsusMarkdownEditor.ClearSearch.

dispositions.reason: The operation opens the Web search bar; the Avalonia editor deliberately exposes search data without built-in search chrome.
dispositions.alternative: Open host search chrome and call FsusMarkdownEditor.RequestSearch.

dispositions.reason: This operation dispatches the Web search-and-replace chrome action rather than a distinct document primitive.
dispositions.alternative: The native host computes replacements and submits one FsusMarkdownEditor.DispatchTransaction.

dispositions.reason: This operation dispatches the Web search-and-replace chrome action rather than a distinct document primitive.
dispositions.alternative: The native host computes the current replacement and submits FsusMarkdownEditor.DispatchTransaction.

dispositions.reason: The exposed value is the Web search-chrome view state, not a callable platform-neutral operation.
dispositions.alternative: The native host owns search-chrome state and uses RequestSearch, CommitSearch, NavigateSearch, and ClearSearch.

dispositions.reason: The scoped slot replaces Web footer markup; Avalonia status presentation is host composition rather than a control ContentProperty.
dispositions.alternative: Compose native status UI around CapabilityState, StatusDensity, and host metrics.
